definitions.Meaning: Patient identifier in the registry file.
Age at diagnosis: A1 (16 years or younger), A2 (17 to 40 years), A3 (Over 40 years), or N/A.
Recorded disease location before first surgery; preserve the supplied L categories, 0 and N/A.
Recorded disease behavior; includes B1/B2/B3, perianal variants, 0 and N/A.
UC extent: E1 (Ulcerative proctitis), E2 (Left-sided UC), E3 (Extensive UC / Pancolitis), or N/A.
Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn’s Disease (SES-CD). Reported observed values 0–29, mostly 0, with missing values.
Recorded modified Baron score. Values and coding have not yet been supplied.
Harvey-Bradshaw Index (HBI), a Crohn’s disease clinical activity score. Reported observed values 0–19, with possible missing values.
Simple Clinical Colitis Activity Index (SCCAI), a UC clinical activity score. Reported observed values 0–12, with possible missing values.

purpose: PRISM diagnosis, disease classification, endoscopy dates and clinical/endoscopic activity scores.
